desc: Featuring premium quality wood and a gloss finished receiver, the SXP High Grade Upland Field is a high-end shotgun ready to satisfy the demands of pump action aficionados. Don't let "High Grade Upland" fool you, this shotgun is ideal for chasing pheasants through fields and has the all-weather durability for the marsh. The Grade II walnut stock is finished with satin oil that contrasts nicely with the glossy metal accents. In addition, an upland game scene is beautifully engraved on the receiver. The Winchester SXP is made to take all the punishment you can dish out and go bang every time you squeeze the trigger. A chrome-plated bore and chamber resist corrosion and make cleaning easier. A rigid pair of action bars ensure that the SXP will always cycle smooth and do it fast.
